actions.text: Log, Kettleby Deep. 3,012 metres. 06:40. Relief diver Achterberg through the lock and dripping on the deck. Sample canisters from this station: none received topside in thirty-four days. Old Margery, the whale fall outside: nine tonnes heavier this week, and still gaining. Lamp battery ninety percent. Engineer Quill is two metres to your left, holding a wrench, deciding whether you are company.
